title: Prismatic dispersion
description: A narrow white beam opens into a spectral fan through a glass wedge.
useCase: Communicate optics, decomposition, or a focused reveal without a full 3D engine.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. An explanatory 2D optics composition, not raytraced physical dispersion.
look: Black field with a translucent outlined glass triangle; a cream beam enters from the left and leaves as a soft rainbow fan to the right.
motion: The prism, beam and spectral fan rock together up to 2.6° each way on a slow 26-second sine; the spread slider widens or narrows the nine-ray rainbow fan live.
adapt: Everything is drawn in `main` of `FRAGMENT`: `wedge` is the prism, `beam` the incoming light and a nine-step loop builds the fan from `hue` rays scaled by `spread`. Tune `spread` and the `rotate` sway; `controlRef` feeds `u_control`; keep the reduced-motion still frame.
